info.title: Incident Room API
info.description: Production REST API for Incident Room â a gamified SRE/DevOps incident response learning platform. Supports anonymous play with 256-bit capability tokens, stateless JWT cookie authentication, scenario catalog filtering, interactive gameplay telemetry feeds, debrief scoring, leaderboards, and admin YAML authoring.

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit code sent by email. Sets HTTP-only auth cookies on success.

400.description: Validation failed for email or code format

200.description: Email verified â session established, returns user response

post.description: Verifies password reset code and sets a new password. Revokes all existing sessions.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or rate-limited reset code

post.description: Resends a new 6-digit email verification code to an unverified user account.

202.description: Accepted â verification code sent if account needs verification

post.description: Creates a new user account and sends a 6-digit verification code by email.

400.description: Validation failed for email, password, or displayName

202.description: Accepted â verification email sent if account is available

post.description: Refreshes the JWT access token using the HttpOnly ir_refresh cookie. Rotates the refresh token.

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked refresh token

post.description: Revokes the current refresh token and clears all authentication cookies.
Revokes all active refresh token sessions across all devices for the current user.
Authenticates user credentials. Sets ir_access, ir_refresh, and ir_csrf cookies on success.

403.description: Account exists but email is not verified yet

post.description: Generates a 6-digit password reset code and emails it if an account exists for the given address.
Creates a new attempt for a scenario. Supports both anonymous players (returns capabilityToken) and authenticated users.

404.description: Scenario not found or not published

post.description: Commits a remediation action (REMEDIATE kind) to resolve the incident and get final debrief & score.

404.description: Attempt or action key not found

200.description: Incident resolved â returns full debrief score breakdown

400.description: Invalid action key, not REMEDIATE kind, or attempt already resolved

post.description: Runs a diagnostic action (INVESTIGATE kind) to reveal additional telemetry signals.

404.description: Attempt or action key not found

400.description: Invalid action key or action is REMEDIATE kind

post.description: Links anonymous attempts played prior to account creation to the now-authenticated user account.

400.description: Empty token list or list size exceeds 20 max

200.description: Claim result response â count of newly linked attempts

post.description: Parses and persists a scenario definition from raw YAML text. Always creates or updates a draft (unpublished).

200.description: Scenario imported as draft, returns validation warnings if any

404.description: Not found (if caller is not authenticated or not ROLE_ADMIN)

400.description: YAML syntax error or invalid structure

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user account and all linked data (attempts, refresh tokens, leaderboard entries, verification codes).

204.description: Account permanently deleted and cookies cleared

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's display name.
Saves the player's free-text hypothesis before committing to a remediation.
Publishes or unpublishes a scenario by ID. Publishing requires scenario validation check to pass.

404.description: Scenario ID not found or non-admin caller

patch.description: Assigns a scenario to be the designated daily incident for a specific UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

get.description: Total completed incidents and average score across the authenticated user's full history â computed server-side via aggregation, not limited to one page of attempts.
Returns a complete JSON archive of the authenticated user's account profile, streak data, attempt history, and leaderboard records.

200.description: Complete user data export JSON payload

get.description: Returns a paginated history of all incident attempts played by the authenticated user.

200.description: Paginated list of user attempt summaries

get.description: Returns slug and last modified timestamp for all published scenarios for sitemap generation.

200.description: List of published scenario sitemap entries

get.description: Returns a paginated list of published incident scenarios with optional difficulty and root cause class filters.

parameters.name: difficulty
parameters.description: Filter by difficulty level (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD)

parameters.name: rootCauseClass
parameters.description: Filter by root cause class (e.g. cache_stampede)

get.description: Returns public scenario details. Answer keys and gated telemetry are stripped server-side.

404.description: Scenario not found or not published

get.description: Returns paginated high-score leaderboard entries for a specific scenario.

404.description: Scenario not found or not published

200.description: List of root cause category strings

get.description: Returns which OAuth2 providers (google, github) are currently configured on this deployment, so the frontend can show only working sign-in buttons instead of hardcoding provider availability separately from the backend's actual GOOGLE/GITHUB_OAUTH_* config. An empty list means only email/password sign-in is available. Initiate a flow via GET /oauth2/authorization/{provider} for any ID returned here.

200.description: List of configured provider IDs, e.g. ["google", "github"]

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's profile state and daily streak.
Fetches current state of an in-progress attempt to hydrate the play screen after page reload.

409.description: Attempt exists but has not been resolved yet

get.description: Paginated list of ALL scenarios â drafts and published â with an optional published filter. This is the backend-authoritative source for what scenarios exist; the admin console should treat this as ground truth rather than any client-side cache of past imports.

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: Filter to only published (true) or only draft (false) scenarios; omit for both

404.description: Not found (if caller is not authenticated or not ROLE_ADMIN)

get.description: Full admin view of a scenario by ID â includes the answer key (remediation outcomes) and gated telemetry references, which the public detail endpoint strips.

404.description: Scenario ID not found, or caller is not authenticated / not ROLE_ADMIN

delete.description: Permanently deletes a scenario. Refuses if the scenario is currently published â unpublish it first. Historical attempts/leaderboard entries referencing a deleted scenario degrade gracefully rather than erroring.

404.description: Scenario ID not found, or caller is not authenticated / not ROLE_ADMIN

409.description: Scenario is currently published â unpublish before deleting
